row.evidence: Airbase is now sold as Airbase by Paylocity through a 'Request Pricing with a Free Demo' form with no tiers; Okta's and Microsoft's catalogues list Airbase apps with SCIM provisioning, but Airbase's own docs sit behind a customer login, so the plan gate is not public.
row.notes: New row. airbase.com/pricing redirects to Paylocity's quote form, so no plan or price is public. SCIM exists: Okta OIN app (SAML + SCIM; Create, Update, Deactivate) and Microsoft Entra gallery app with a provisioning tutorial (Base URL and API Token from Users > Sync with HRIS; maps core, enterprise and Airbase-extension attributes accountingPolicy, subsidiary, role). Which plan includes SCIM or SSO is not published, so status is unknown. SSO appears to run through WorkOS (Entra reply URL auth.workos.com). Help centre and API docs require login.

plans.name: Airbase by Paylocity (quote only)
plans.price_text: Request Pricing with a Free Demo (no public tiers)
plans.notes: airbase.com/pricing now 301-redirects to paylocity.com/pricing, a demo-request form with no Airbase tiers or prices.

scim.notes: SCIM evidence comes only from IdP pages: Okta's OIN app (page markup checks SAML and SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate; last updated Feb 1 2021) and Microsoft's Entra provisioning tutorial, which takes a Base URL and API Token from Airbase Users > Sync with HRIS > Microsoft Entra ID and maps userName, active, emails[type eq "work"].value, name.givenName, name.familyName, externalId, enterprise department and manager, and Airbase extension attributes accountingPolicy, subsidiary and role (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:airbase:2.0:User). Kept out of the vendor-docs fields (operations, attributes, row.scim_ops) because Airbase's own help centre requires a login.

user_api.notes: docs.airbase.io redirects to a Cloudflare Access login; no public Airbase API reference was found.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML and SCIM, provisioning Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push). Builder not stated.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SAML SSO (SP and IdP initiated; reply URL can be a WorkOS ACS URL) and provisioning (create, remove, sync attributes) using a tenant URL and token from Airbase.

onelogin.notes: onelogin.com/connector/airbase returned a bot-check (HTTP 202); not verified.

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com/integrations/airbase returned 404; support page blocked (403). Not verified.

fallbacks.notes: Airbase help centre (help.airbase.com, now a Paylocity eGain portal) is an authenticated portal; docs.airbase.io sits behind Cloudflare Access. The Entra page places the SCIM token under 'Sync with HRIS', and the SSO tutorial says users must be created by Airbase support before SSO (Microsoft boilerplate), so JIT is not established.
